title: AIOS Unit — Base Frontmatter
description: Fields every addressable AIOS unit carries in its YAML frontmatter, in every module. Type-specific schemas (standard, agent, guardrail, ...) reference this via allOf and add their own fields. Consumed by the M2 schema validator; authored in M1 per Decision 0001.

id.description: Canonical address. MUST equal the file's path under .ai/ with no extension — e.g. a file at standards/security/no-plaintext-secrets.md has id 'standards/security/no-plaintext-secrets'. This makes the namespace machine-checkable: a rename that breaks a reference is detectable, not a matter of luck.

owner.description: The single role/person who can attest this unit is still true. Never empty, never co-owned.

category.description: First-level Router partition within the unit's module (e.g. 'security' for a Standard). Type schemas constrain this to the module's declared category set.

depends_on.description: ids of other units this one assumes as already true. Drives the reverse-dependency index and Impact Analysis (governance/README.md#impact-analysis).

validated_against.description: For each dependency, the '{id}@{version}' it was last checked against. A mismatch with the dependency's current version is what Impact Analysis flags as NeedsRevalidation. Enables producer/consumer sync without lockstep bumping (governance/README.md#release-management).

supersedes.description: id of the unit this one replaces, if any. Set when a Deprecated unit names its successor.
